# 🎬 **KREA 2 — Models & Installation Guide**

> ✨ **Complete model setup for running KREA 2 inside ComfyUI**

---

## 🧩 Guide

🔗 **ComfyUI Subgraph Guide**
[📖 Subgraph Documentation](https://docs.comfy.org/interface/features/subgraph)

---

# 🤗 **MODEL DOWNLOADS**

### 🚀 BF16 / NVFP4 Variants

For **BF16** and **NVFP4** versions of KREA 2:

🔗 [**Comfy-Org / Krea-2**](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Krea-2)

---

## 🧠 `DIFFUSION MODEL`

> 🔵 **Main KREA 2 generation model**

📦 **`krea2_turbo_fp8_scaled.safetensors`**

[⬇️ Download Diffusion Model](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Krea-2/resolve/main/diffusion_models/krea2_turbo_fp8_scaled.safetensors)

📁 **Install to:**

```text
ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/
```

---

## 💬 `TEXT ENCODER`

> 🟣 **Qwen3-VL 4B FP8 Text Encoder**

📦 **`qwen3vl_4b_fp8_scaled.safetensors`**

[⬇️ Download Text Encoder](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Krea-2/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_4b_fp8_scaled.safetensors)

📁 **Install to:**

```text
ComfyUI/models/text_encoders/
```

---

## 🎨 `VAE`

> 🟠 **Wan 2.1 VAE**

📦 **`Wan_2.1_vae.safetensors`**

[⬇️ Download VAE](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Wan_2.1_ComfyUI_repackaged/blob/main/split_files/vae/wan_2.1_vae.safetensors)

📁 **Install to:**

```text
ComfyUI/models/vae/
```

---

# 🎞️ **KREA 2 LoRAs**

### 📸 Canon Ultra Real

> Photorealistic / camera-oriented KREA 2 LoRA

[🔥 **KREA 2 — Canon UltraReal**](https://civitai.red/models/2783143/canon-ultrareal)

### 🎥 Cinematic Movie Still

> Cinematic film-frame / movie-still oriented KREA 2 LoRA

[🎬 **KREA 2 — Cinematic Movie Still**](https://civitai.red/models/2840790/cinematic-movie-still)

📁 **Install LoRAs to:**

```text
ComfyUI/models/loras/
```

---

# 🎛️ **CONTROLNET**

## 🧩 Custom Node

> 🟢 **KREA 2 ControlNet support for ComfyUI**

🔗 [**KREACONTROLNET_NODE**](https://github.com/facok/comfyui-krea2-controlnet)

📁 **Install to:**

```text
ComfyUI/custom_nodes/comfyui-krea2-controlnet/
```

---

## 🗺️ Depth ControlNet LoRA — `REQUIRED`

> ⚠️ **Required for KREA 2 Depth ControlNet**

🔗 [**KREACONTROLNET_LORA — KREA 2 Depth ControlNet**](https://huggingface.co/Patil/Krea-2-depth-controlnet/tree/main)

📁 Place the required LoRA/model files in the appropriate **ComfyUI model directory** used by the ControlNet node.

---

# 📂 **MODEL STORAGE STRUCTURE**

```text
📂 ComfyUI/
│
├── 📂 models/
│   │
│   ├── 🧠 diffusion_models/
│   │   └── 🚀 krea2_turbo_fp8_scaled.safetensors
│   │
│   ├── 💬 text_encoders/
│   │   └── 🔤 qwen3vl_4b_fp8_scaled.safetensors
│   │
│   ├── 🎨 vae/
│   │   └── 🖼️ Wan_2.1_vae.safetensors
│   │
│   └── 🎞️ loras/
│       ├── 📸 krea2_CanonUltraReal.safetensors
│       ├── 🎬 krea2_CinematicMovieStill.safetensors
│       └── 🗺️ KREA2_Depth_ControlNet_LoRA.safetensors
│
└── 📂 custom_nodes/
    └── 🧩 comfyui-krea2-controlnet/
```

---

# ⚡ **QUICK SETUP**

**1️⃣ Diffusion Model** → `models/diffusion_models/`
**2️⃣ Qwen Text Encoder** → `models/text_encoders/`
**3️⃣ VAE** → `models/vae/`
**4️⃣ KREA LoRAs** → `models/loras/`
**5️⃣ ControlNet Custom Node** → `custom_nodes/`
**6️⃣ Depth ControlNet LoRA** → Install for ControlNet usage
**7️⃣ Restart ComfyUI** 🔄

---

### 🎬 **KREA 2 • COMFYUI**

**Generate • Stylize • Control • Create**

A complete **Krea 2 Film Studio** generation node built inside ComfyUI, designed to keep the entire image workflow inside one clean interface. It supports **Text-to-Image, Image-to-Image, Directed Control, custom resolutions, megapixel scaling, sampler settings, seeds, LoRA loading, prompt history, gallery, autosave, and model settings**, while still outputting a standard ComfyUI **IMAGE, LATENT, and used seed** for use with other nodes.

The goal is to make Krea 2 feel like a standalone creative studio while keeping everything fully local and integrated with ComfyUI.
